articles.title: Citi Tells Some Staff to Work From Home After Foiled Bomb Plot at BofA in Paris
articles.mainIdea: Citi Tells Some Staff to Work From Home After Foiled Bomb Plot at BofA in Paris
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Citi Tells Some Staff to Work From Home After Foiled Bomb Plot at BofA in Paris. Citigroup has asked its employees in Paris and Frankfurt to work from home as a precautionary measure following a foiled bomb plot last week against a Bank of America office in the French capital. “The safety of our employees is our top priority, and we are taking the necessary measures to ensure their protection,” a Citi spokeswoman said. “Employees in Paris and Frankfurt are working remotely as a precautionary measure,” she added without specifying how long the measure would be in place.

articles.title: BoE to hike before cutting, says BofA as energy shock persists
articles.mainIdea: BoE to hike before cutting, says BofA as energy shock persists
articles.summary: Investing.com: BoE to hike before cutting, says BofA as energy shock persists. Investing.com -- Bank of America now expects the Bank of England to raise interest rates twice before pivoting to cuts, as high energy prices raise the risk of second-round inflation effects feeding through to the broader U.K. economy.
